description: For research modes (deep research, company knowledge). In chat, use search_guides instead. Searches all public BeautySpark content: guide sections (id "<locale>/<slug>#<anchor>"), article looks (id "look:<id>") and colour-season palette pages (id "season:<season>"). Read any result with fetch.

locale.description: The user's language as a language tag, e.g. "de" or "pt-BR". Set it from the user's language. Defaults to English.

name: search
title: Search BeautySpark (research)
